scientific_scope: Published structured data from historical computations. Potential model memberships are not observed commuting flows. The newly agreed functional-gravity model is not computed.
formats: Original Parquet and other structured formats, byte-exact; ZIP stores each unique Git blob once. Original paths reconstructed from catalog.

profiles.all: All8919 published structured-data paths, including older scenarios and supporting data.
